information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTg3NzY2LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--baad0ffa68c853ed34e6b5f7772b1d3f681c2028/IMG_0509.png) ### Welcome to Philippine Championship 2026! The **Negros Speedcubers Organizing Committee** (NSOC) proudly presents the 15th World Cube Association National Championship for the **Philippines**, the annual culmination of the best Filipino speedcubers in their respective events. This competition brings together the nation's top talents for an exciting showcase of skill, determination, and sportsmanship. Only the **top three** winners representing the **Philippines** of each category will receive physical awards such as medals and plaques. The top three winners of any Finals, regardless of nationality, will be recognized together with the top three at the awarding ceremony. Looking for 3x3 Fewest Moves? Check out [Philippine FMC Championship 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PhilippineFMCChampionship2026). ###### *Page unavailable? The competition hasn't been announced yet.
